io.name: clk
io.description: Clock input; counter advances on the positive edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset; when high at a positive clock edge, q is set to 0.

io.name: q
io.description: Decade counter output, counting 0 through 9 inclusive with period 10.

functional_summary.overview: A 4-bit decade counter that counts from 0 to 9 inclusive and wraps back to 0, giving a period of 10. The active-high synchronous reset forces the counter to 0 on the positive clock edge.
rules: On each positive clock edge, if reset is high, q is set to 0.
On each positive clock edge, if reset is low and q is 9, q is set to 0.
On each positive clock edge, if reset is low and q is less than 9, q is incremented by 1.
q only takes values 0 through 9; values 10 through 15 never occur in normal operation.
The output q reflects the counter value after the positive clock edge has settled.
